changedBehavior: Add an additive, deterministic PR regression manifest and selected-test gate while preserving the existing full authoritative validation.
expectedAssertions: Malformed or missing manifests, references, categories and selectors fail with an actionable error.
Unknown paths and selectors that match zero executable checks fail closed.
CI-owned selectors are unioned with manifest selectors and cannot be removed by PR metadata.
New commits and edited manifest references produce a fresh plan bound to the current head.
The existing ui-ux-review and complete native regression matrix remain required.
